chords pushed.about: two bars leaning with the harmony: the first chord for three and a half beats, the second pushed on the and of four (down), the third on three of the next bar (up)

chords pushed cool.about: chords pushed, with the pushed chord leaning cooler as well as down: for a minor chord under a warm or magenta look

kick one and four-and.about: small lifts on one, the and of one, the and of two and the and of four: a driving kick, read from the kick stem

snare on three.about: a lift on beat three of every bar, falling away: a half-time backbeat, read from the snare stem

verse chords pushed.about: four bars leaning with a verse's harmony, the second and fourth chords each pushed on the and of four; half a turn late, for a verse that starts two bars off the four-bar grid
